title.narrative: # of people receiving direct assistance via humanitarian programmes, disaggregated by region/country

description.narrative: The indicator documents the number of people directly reached via humanitarian programmes. This includes people provided with tangible goods and materials, services and supported through activities designed to raise knowledge, awareness and skills. The indicator does not count people reached indirectly, such as those benefiting from enhanced capacity of institutions, or those affected by policy changes. This is a standard output indicator under the Strategic Partnership Agreement with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. It seeks to provide a sense of scale across change contributions funded by the agreement. Narrative case studies compliment the indicator to capture change contributions.

description.narrative: This indicator captures the scale for humanitarian interventions aimed at directly supporting people. This helps ensuring that case studies developed by SPA partners covering humanitarian work are located within the wider portfolio of work.

comment.narrative: Danmission's local partner counted the total number of families reached: 1370. Based on this an estimate of total people reached has been made, couting the average family as consisting of 1 male above 18, one female above 18, and three children, half boys half girls.
